evidence: Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h, and src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp to add a block validation API endpoint and C++ wrapper.
rationale: Adds a C API endpoint and C++ wrapper enabling external libbitcoinkernel consumers to validate blocks without maintaining a complete UTXO set. This provides significant API completeness for lightweight and external indexing use cases. Because it also introduces substantive block validation logic into ChainstateManager, it spans both kernel and validation and probably needs splitting.
